name: today-mod
description: /today: the day's agenda for Claude and for you. Calendar events, E3 deadlines and Reminders are read through the macos and nycu plugin scripts, shown as one line above the prompt with a countdown to the next event, and handed to Claude as a context block so it knows your day.

scriptsDir.title: Legacy shared scripts directory
scriptsDir.description: Optional explicit directory for all three scripts. Prefer the separate macos and nycu overrides. Empty resolves installed plugins automatically.

refreshMs.title: Refresh interval
refreshMs.description: Milliseconds between re-reads of the three sources, shared by every open session. 300000 (5 minutes) by default; 60000 at the least.

dueDays.title: E3 deadline window
dueDays.description: Days ahead to list E3 deadlines. 7 by default.

remindersList.title: Reminders list
remindersList.description: The Reminders list to read. TODO by default.

showOnStart.title: Show on start
showOnStart.description: Show the line as soon as an interactive session starts. The last /today on|off choice, once made, wins over this.

macosScriptsDir.title: macos scripts directory
macosScriptsDir.description: Optional scripts directory override for macos. Empty resolves the current macos@zyx1121 user installation.

nycuScriptsDir.title: nycu scripts directory
nycuScriptsDir.description: Optional scripts directory override for nycu. Empty resolves the current nycu@zyx1121 user installation.
